Cosmere.Core.Def.CosmereFeatureDef.label: highstorms
Cosmere.Core.Def.CosmereFeatureDef.description: Storms out of the east strong enough to hurl boulders, and the Stormlight they leave behind in every gem they pass over.

Cosmere.Core.Def.CosmereFeatureDef.label: Stormlight infrastructure
Cosmere.Core.Def.CosmereFeatureDef.description: Spheres and gems holding Stormlight, and the lamps and fabrials that draw on them.

Cosmere.Core.Def.CosmereFeatureDef.label: spren
Cosmere.Core.Def.CosmereFeatureDef.description: Living bits of Investiture that gather where the thing they are drawn to is happening - flame, fear, rot, joy.

Cosmere.Core.Def.CosmereFeatureDef.label: the Nightwatcher
Cosmere.Core.Def.CosmereFeatureDef.description: The valley, and what waits in it. She grants a boon and takes a curse, and does not negotiate about which.
